title: I Was SCARED To Say This To NASA... (But I said it anyway) - Smarter Every Day 293
summary: Destin Sandlin of Smarter Every Day gives a talk to an aerospace audience, comparing how Apollo was engineered and managed with NASA's Artemis program. He raises concerns about unresolved details, the number of launches and in-orbit fuel transfer needed to reach the Moon, and the loss of institutional knowledge.
why: Commenters point to it whenever Artemis, SLS or Starship refueling comes up, as a candid and critical engineering assessment delivered directly to NASA.

quote.text: one of the bravest talks I’ve seen in a while about the lessons of the Apollo program for Artemis
